to: NousResearch/hermes-agent maintainers or commercial team via the repository's public contact route
subject: Bounded ai-agents integration pilot for NousResearch/hermes-agent
body:
Hello NousResearch team,

Unsolicited note about hermes-agent — I don't think you posted a contract, this is a speculative paid-pilot approach based on the public repo. The README frames the project as 'the agent that grows with you' and the Python codebase carries the anthropic/claude-code/hermes topic set, which reads to me as an agent-loop project that will accumulate integration and eval seams faster than most maintainer teams will want to hand-write regression tests for. That's the wedge for a bounded paid pilot: I pick one integration or verification seam that today only gets exercised by 'run it manually and see', and ship a minimal Python adapter plus a failing-path test that doesn't touch your public API, with an exportable receipt of what ran.

Proposed first milestone (paid, fixed-scope):
1. Identify one seam in hermes-agent maintainers currently test manually.
2. Implement a minimal adapter + failing-path test that leaves the public API untouched.
3. Deliver the patch, a reproducible acceptance check, and a short maintainer runbook.

Proof: https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ ships 21 live browser games, and https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 exposes the append-only receipt/operator-gated effect model I use on agent work. I'm proposing integration labor, not asking NousResearch to adopt any of the surrounding infrastructure.

If that seam is real for hermes-agent, book 15 minutes: {{OPERATOR_BOOKING_LINK}}. Otherwise no follow-up.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
